value: Shader language support notes for Yotsuba Framework.
Use the shader authoring language that best fits your project and target platform.
Yotsuba Framework supports multiple shader paths instead of forcing one language everywhere.
Author shaders with MGFX, FNAFX, Slang, native HLSL, GLSL or MSL, and use direct SPIR-V input when your pipeline already produces compiled shader binaries.
Choose the shader language that fits the platform without changing the framework model.
Keep existing effect workflows where they make sense and introduce newer shader languages when a project needs broader language features or platform-specific control.
